# Debrief: Istio, Envoy

These clips cover Istio's evolution from Envoy sidecars to ambient mesh with ztunnel, how GitHub runs Istio at scale, Envoy extensibility, and a Bloomberg migration to Istio. ([Evolution or Revolution: Istio as the Network Platform for Cloud Native · 4:24](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4K6s5y8HoBc&t=264s); [Evolution or Revolution: Istio as the Network Platform for Cloud Native · 13:08](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4K6s5y8HoBc&t=788s); [Istio in Production: Expected Value, Results, and Effort at GitHub Scale · 4:12](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2fXwQylR2lw&t=252s); [Zero-Downtime Migration from ingress-nginx to Istio in a Multi-Cluster Kubernetes Platform at Bloomberg · 14:20](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wix_PfQ61jY&t=860s))

## Top 3 takeaways

1. Istio ran only Envoy sidecars for five years; sidecars proved mesh value but forced restarting every pod to upgrade, so ztunnel, a per-node L4 proxy handling mTLS, was introduced. ([Evolution or Revolution: Istio as the Network Platform for Cloud Native · 4:24](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4K6s5y8HoBc&t=264s))
2. Ztunnel is a smaller Rust codebase with higher throughput and lower latency than full Envoy for L4 routing and mTLS. Calico's Tigera operator installs Istio and ztunnel using a ztunnel fork. ([Evolution or Revolution: Istio as the Network Platform for Cloud Native · 13:08](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4K6s5y8HoBc&t=788s))
3. Ambient adoption has friction: Gateway API is not native in every tool, so tools like Argo Rollouts need plugins, and cert-manager needs an experimental feature enabled. Ambient multicluster just reached beta in Istio 1.29. ([The Good, The Ugly, and The Bad: Leaving Sidecars Behind with Istio Ambient Mesh · 21:59](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ToKv7JntLvY&t=1319s); [Istio in Production: Expected Value, Results, and Effort at GitHub Scale · 21:18](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2fXwQylR2lw&t=1278s))

## Action items

- [ ] Inventory tooling that touches traffic or certificates, such as rollout controllers and cert-manager, and check whether each needs a Gateway API plugin or experimental flag before evaluating ambient. ([The Good, The Ugly, and The Bad: Leaving Sidecars Behind with Istio Ambient Mesh · 21:59](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ToKv7JntLvY&t=1319s))
- [ ] Plan an Istio upgrade trial using parallel Istiod versions in one mesh, rolling workloads progressively with easy rollback to limit blast radius. ([Evolution or Revolution: Istio as the Network Platform for Cloud Native · 4:24](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4K6s5y8HoBc&t=264s))
- [ ] Review Bloomberg's phased rollout-by-datacenter approach as a model for moving ingress to Envoy-based Istio without downtime. ([Zero-Downtime Migration from ingress-nginx to Istio in a Multi-Cluster Kubernetes Platform at Bloomberg · 14:20](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wix_PfQ61jY&t=860s))

## Watch together (10 min)

1. [Evolution or Revolution: Istio as the Network Platform for Cloud Native · 4:24](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4K6s5y8HoBc&t=264s) (1:25), Mitch Connors, Daniel Grimm: Explains why ztunnel was introduced over sidecars and upgrade pain.
2. [The Good, The Ugly, and The Bad: Leaving Sidecars Behind with Istio Ambient Mesh · 21:59](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ToKv7JntLvY&t=1319s) (1:21), Alfonso Ming, Jorge Turrado: Honest ambient adoption pitfalls around Gateway API tooling.
3. [Istio in Production: Expected Value, Results, and Effort at GitHub Scale · 21:18](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2fXwQylR2lw&t=1278s) (2:18), Mitch Connors, Golnaz Rouhi: GitHub-scale lessons: ambient multicluster, Gateway API, deny-by-default.
4. [Zero-Downtime Migration from ingress-nginx to Istio in a Multi-Cluster Kubernetes Platform at Bloomberg · 14:20](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wix_PfQ61jY&t=860s) (3:37), Joe Abellard: Zero-downtime migration strategies for moving ingress onto Envoy.
5. [Evolution or Revolution: Istio as the Network Platform for Cloud Native · 13:08](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4K6s5y8HoBc&t=788s) (1:19), Mitch Connors, Daniel Grimm: Ztunnel performance, Rust codebase, and CNI integrations like Calico.
